versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֧עַשׂ בְּצַלְאֵ֛ל אֶת־הָאָרֹ֖ן עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים אַמָּתַ֨יִם וָחֵ֜צִי אָרְכּ֗וֹ וְאַמָּ֤ה וָחֵ֨צִי֙ רָחְבּ֔וֹ וְאַמָּ֥ה וָחֵ֖צִי קֹמָתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Bezalel made the ark of acacia wood. Its length was two and a half cubits, and its breadth a cubit and a half, and a cubit and a half its height.
controles.kjv: And Bezaleel made the ark of shittim wood: two cubits and a half was the length of it, and a cubit and a half the breadth of it, and a cubit and a half the height of it:
controles.livre: Fez também Bezalel a arca de madeira de acácia: seu comprimento era de dois côvados e meio, e de côvado e meio sua largura, e sua altura de outro côvado e meio:

versos.hebraico: וַיְצַפֵּ֛הוּ זָהָ֥ב טָה֖וֹר מִבַּ֣יִת וּמִח֑וּץ וַיַּ֥עַשׂ ל֛וֹ זֵ֥ר זָהָ֖ב סָבִֽיב׃

controles.web: He overlaid it with pure gold inside and outside, and made a molding of gold for it around it.
controles.kjv: And he overlaid it with pure gold within and without, and made a crown of gold to it round about.
controles.livre: E cobriu-a de ouro puro por de dentro e por de fora, e fez-lhe uma borda de ouro em derredor.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּצֹ֣ק ל֗וֹ אַרְבַּע֙ טַבְּעֹ֣ת זָהָ֔ב עַ֖ל אַרְבַּ֣ע פַּעֲמֹתָ֑יו וּשְׁתֵּ֣י טַבָּעֹ֗ת עַל־צַלְעוֹ֙ הָֽאֶחָ֔ת וּשְׁתֵּי֙ טַבָּע֔וֹת עַל־צַלְע֖וֹ הַשֵּׁנִֽית׃

controles.web: He cast four rings of gold for it, in its four feet; even two rings on its one side, and two rings on its other side.
controles.kjv: And he cast for it four rings of gold, to be set by the four corners of it; even two rings upon the one side of it, and two rings upon the other side of it.
controles.livre: Fez-lhe também de fundição quatro anéis de ouro a seus quatro cantos; em um lado dois anéis e no outro lado dois anéis.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ בַּדֵּ֖י עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים וַיְצַ֥ף אֹתָ֖ם זָהָֽב׃

controles.web: He made poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold.
controles.kjv: And he made staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold.
controles.livre: Fez também as varas de madeira de acácia, e cobriu-as de ouro.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּבֵ֤א אֶת־הַבַּדִּים֙ בַּטַּבָּעֹ֔ת עַ֖ל צַלְעֹ֣ת הָאָרֹ֑ן לָשֵׂ֖את אֶת־הָאָרֹֽן׃

controles.web: He put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark, to bear the ark.
controles.kjv: And he put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, to bear the ark.
controles.livre: E meteu as varas pelos anéis aos lados da arca, para levar a arca.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ כַּפֹּ֖רֶת זָהָ֣ב טָה֑וֹר אַמָּתַ֤יִם וָחֵ֨צִי֙ אָרְכָּ֔הּ וְאַמָּ֥ה וָחֵ֖צִי רָחְבָּֽהּ׃

controles.web: He made a mercy seat of pure gold. Its length was two and a half cubits, and a cubit and a half its breadth.
controles.kjv: And he made the mercy seat of pure gold: two cubits and a half was the length thereof, and one cubit and a half the breadth thereof.
controles.livre: Fez também a coberta de ouro puro: seu comprimento de dois côvados e meio, e sua largura de côvado e meio.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֛עַשׂ שְׁנֵ֥י כְרֻבִ֖ים זָהָ֑ב מִקְשָׁה֙ עָשָׂ֣ה אֹתָ֔ם מִשְּׁנֵ֖י קְצ֥וֹת הַכַּפֹּֽרֶת׃

controles.web: He made two cherubim of gold. He made them of beaten work, at the two ends of the mercy seat;
controles.kjv: And he made two cherubims of gold, beaten out of one piece made he them, on the two ends of the mercy seat;
controles.livre: Fez também os dois querubins de ouro, os fez lavrados a martelo, aos duas extremidades do propiciatório:

versos.hebraico: כְּרוּב־אֶחָ֤ד מִקָּצָה֙ מִזֶּ֔ה וּכְרוּב־אֶחָ֥ד מִקָּצָ֖ה מִזֶּ֑ה מִן־הַכַּפֹּ֛רֶת עָשָׂ֥ה אֶת־הַכְּרֻבִ֖ים מִשְּׁנֵ֥י קצוותו׃

controles.web: one cherub at the one end, and one cherub at the other end. He made the cherubim of one piece with the mercy seat at its two ends.
controles.kjv: One cherub on the end on this side, and another cherub on the other end on that side: out of the mercy seat made he the cherubims on the two ends thereof.
controles.livre: Um querubim desta parte ao um extremo, e o outro querubim da outra parte ao outro extremo do propiciatório: fez os querubins a suas duas extremidades.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּהְי֣וּ הַכְּרֻבִים֩ פֹּרְשֵׂ֨י כְנָפַ֜יִם לְמַ֗עְלָה סֹֽכְכִ֤ים בְּכַנְפֵיהֶם֙ עַל־הַכַּפֹּ֔רֶת וּפְנֵיהֶ֖ם אִ֣ישׁ אֶל־אָחִ֑יו אֶל־הַכַּפֹּ֔רֶת הָי֖וּ פְּנֵ֥י הַכְּרֻבִֽים׃פ

controles.web: The cherubim spread out their wings on high, covering the mercy seat with their wings, with their faces toward one another. The faces of the cherubim were toward the mercy seat.
controles.kjv: And the cherubims spread out their wings on high, and covered with their wings over the mercy seat, with their faces one to another; even to the mercy seatward were the faces of the cherubims.
controles.livre: E os querubins estendiam suas asas por cima, cobrindo com suas asas o propiciatório: e seus rostos um em frente do outro, até o propiciatório os rostos dos querubins.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ אֶת־הַשֻּׁלְחָ֖ן עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים אַמָּתַ֤יִם אָרְכּוֹ֙ וְאַמָּ֣ה רָחְבּ֔וֹ וְאַמָּ֥ה וָחֵ֖צִי קֹמָתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: He made the table of acacia wood. Its length was two cubits, and its breadth was a cubit, and its height was a cubit and a half.
controles.kjv: And he made the table of shittim wood: two cubits was the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof:
controles.livre: Fez também a mesa de madeira de acácia; seu comprimento de dois côvados, e sua largura de um côvado, e de côvado e meio sua altura;

versos.hebraico: וַיְצַ֥ף אֹת֖וֹ זָהָ֣ב טָה֑וֹר וַיַּ֥עַשׂ ל֛וֹ זֵ֥ר זָהָ֖ב סָבִֽיב׃

controles.web: He overlaid it with pure gold, and made a gold molding around it.
controles.kjv: And he overlaid it with pure gold, and made thereunto a crown of gold round about.
controles.livre: E cobriu-a de ouro puro, e fez-lhe uma borda de ouro em derredor.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֨עַשׂ ל֥וֹ מִסְגֶּ֛רֶת טֹ֖פַח סָבִ֑יב וַיַּ֧עַשׂ זֵר־זָהָ֛ב לְמִסְגַּרְתּ֖וֹ סָבִֽיב׃

controles.web: He made a border of a hand breadth around it, and made a golden molding on its border around it.
controles.kjv: Also he made thereunto a border of an handbreadth round about; and made a crown of gold for the border thereof round about.
controles.livre: Fez-lhe também uma moldura ao redor, da largura de uma mão, à qual moldura fez a borda de ouro ao redor.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּצֹ֣ק ל֔וֹ אַרְבַּ֖ע טַבְּעֹ֣ת זָהָ֑ב וַיִּתֵּן֙ אֶת־הַטַּבָּעֹ֔ת עַ֚ל אַרְבַּ֣ע הַפֵּאֹ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֖ר לְאַרְבַּ֥ע רַגְלָֽיו׃

controles.web: He cast four rings of gold for it, and put the rings in the four corners that were on its four feet.
controles.kjv: And he cast for it four rings of gold, and put the rings upon the four corners that were in the four feet thereof.
controles.livre: Fez-lhe também de fundição quatro anéis de ouro, e os pôs aos quatro cantos que correspondiam aos quatro pés dela.

versos.hebraico: לְעֻמַּת֙ הַמִּסְגֶּ֔רֶת הָי֖וּ הַטַּבָּעֹ֑ת בָּתִּים֙ לַבַּדִּ֔ים לָשֵׂ֖את אֶת־הַשֻּׁלְחָֽן׃

controles.web: The rings were close by the border, the places for the poles to carry the table.
controles.kjv: Over against the border were the rings, the places for the staves to bear the table.
controles.livre: Diante da moldura estavam os anéis, pelos quais se metessem as varas para levar a mesa.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֤עַשׂ אֶת־הַבַּדִּים֙ עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֔ים וַיְצַ֥ף אֹתָ֖ם זָהָ֑ב לָשֵׂ֖את אֶת־הַשֻּׁלְחָֽן׃

controles.web: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold, to carry the table.
controles.kjv: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold, to bear the table.
controles.livre: E fez as varas de madeira de acácia para levar a mesa, e cobriu-as de ouro.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֜עַשׂ אֶֽת־הַכֵּלִ֣ים׀ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־הַשֻּׁלְחָ֗ן אֶת־קְעָרֹתָ֤יו וְאֶת־כַּפֹּתָיו֙ וְאֵת֙ מְנַקִּיֹּתָ֔יו וְאֶת־הַקְּשָׂוֺ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֻסַּ֖ךְ בָּהֵ֑ן זָהָ֖ב טָהֽוֹר׃פ

controles.web: He made the vessels which were on the table, its dishes, its spoons, its bowls, and its pitchers with which to pour out, of pure gold.
controles.kjv: And he made the vessels which were upon the table, his dishes, and his spoons, and his bowls, and his covers to cover withal, of pure gold.
controles.livre: Também fez os utensílios que haviam de estar sobre a mesa, seus pratos, e suas colheres, e suas tigelas e suas bacias com que se havia de fazer libações, de ouro fino.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ אֶת־הַמְּנֹרָ֖ה זָהָ֣ב טָה֑וֹר מִקְשָׁ֞ה עָשָׂ֤ה אֶת־הַמְּנֹרָה֙ יְרֵכָ֣הּ וְקָנָ֔הּ גְּבִיעֶ֛יהָ כַּפְתֹּרֶ֥יהָ וּפְרָחֶ֖יהָ מִמֶּ֥נָּה הָיֽוּ׃

controles.web: He made the lamp stand of pure gold. He made the lamp stand of beaten work. Its base, its shaft, its cups, its buds, and its flowers were of one piece with it.
controles.kjv: And he made the candlestick of pure gold: of beaten work made he the candlestick; his shaft, and his branch, his bowls, his knops, and his flowers, were of the same:
controles.livre: Fez também o candelabro de ouro puro, e o fez lavrado a martelo: seu pé e sua haste, seus copos, seus botões e suas flores eram do mesmo.

versos.hebraico: וְשִׁשָּׁ֣ה קָנִ֔ים יֹצְאִ֖ים מִצִּדֶּ֑יהָ שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה׀ קְנֵ֣י מְנֹרָ֗ה מִצִּדָּהּ֙ הָֽאֶחָ֔ד וּשְׁלֹשָׁה֙ קְנֵ֣י מְנֹרָ֔ה מִצִּדָּ֖הּ הַשֵּׁנִֽי׃

controles.web: There were six branches going out of its sides: three branches of the lamp stand out of its one side, and three branches of the lamp stand out of its other side:
controles.kjv: And six branches going out of the sides thereof; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side thereof, and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side thereof:
controles.livre: De seus lados saíam seis braços; três braços de um lado do candelabro, e outros três braços do outro lado do candelabro:

versos.hebraico: שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה גְ֠בִעִים מְֽשֻׁקָּדִ֞ים בַּקָּנֶ֣ה הָאֶחָד֮ כַּפְתֹּ֣ר וָפֶרַח֒ וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה גְבִעִ֗ים מְשֻׁקָּדִ֛ים בְּקָנֶ֥ה אֶחָ֖ד כַּפְתֹּ֣ר וָפָ֑רַח כֵּ֚ן לְשֵׁ֣שֶׁת הַקָּנִ֔ים הַיֹּצְאִ֖ים מִן־הַמְּנֹרָֽה׃

controles.web: three cups made like almond blossoms in one branch, a bud and a flower, and three cups made like almond blossoms in the other branch, a bud and a flower: so for the six branches going out of the lamp stand.
controles.kjv: Three bowls made after the fashion of almonds in one branch, a knop and a flower; and three bowls made like almonds in another branch, a knop and a flower: so throughout the six branches going out of the candlestick.
controles.livre: Em um braço, três copos forma de amêndoas, um botão e uma flor; e no outro braço três copos forma de amêndoas, um botão e uma flor: e assim nos seis braços que saíam do candelabro.

versos.hebraico: וּבַמְּנֹרָ֖ה אַרְבָּעָ֣ה גְבִעִ֑ים מְשֻׁ֨קָּדִ֔ים כַּפְתֹּרֶ֖יהָ וּפְרָחֶֽיהָ׃

controles.web: In the lamp stand were four cups made like almond blossoms, its buds and its flowers;
controles.kjv: And in the candlestick were four bowls made like almonds, his knops, and his flowers:
controles.livre: E no candelabro havia quatro copos forma de amêndoas, seus botões e suas flores:

versos.hebraico: וְכַפְתֹּ֡ר תַּחַת֩ שְׁנֵ֨י הַקָּנִ֜ים מִמֶּ֗נָּה וְכַפְתֹּר֙ תַּ֣חַת שְׁנֵ֤י הַקָּנִים֙ מִמֶּ֔נָּה וְכַפְתֹּ֕ר תַּֽחַת־שְׁנֵ֥י הַקָּנִ֖ים מִמֶּ֑נָּה לְשֵׁ֨שֶׁת֙ הַקָּנִ֔ים הַיֹּצְאִ֖ים מִמֶּֽנָּה׃

controles.web: and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, for the six branches going out of it.
controles.kjv: And a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, according to the six branches going out of it.
controles.livre: E um botão debaixo dos dois braços do mesmo, e outro botão debaixo dos outros dois braços do mesmo, e outro botão debaixo dos outros dois braços do mesmo, conforme os seis braços que saíam dele.

versos.hebraico: כַּפְתֹּרֵיהֶ֥ם וּקְנֹתָ֖ם מִמֶּ֣נָּה הָי֑וּ כֻּלָּ֛הּ מִקְשָׁ֥ה אַחַ֖ת זָהָ֥ב טָהֽוֹר׃

controles.web: Their buds and their branches were of one piece with it. The whole thing was one beaten work of pure gold.
controles.kjv: Their knops and their branches were of the same: all of it was one beaten work of pure gold.
controles.livre: Seus botões e seus braços eram do mesmo; tudo era uma peça lavrada a martelo, de ouro puro.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ אֶת־נֵרֹתֶ֖יהָ שִׁבְעָ֑ה וּמַלְקָחֶ֥יהָ וּמַחְתֹּתֶ֖יהָ זָהָ֥ב טָהֽוֹר׃

controles.web: He made its seven lamps, and its snuffers, and its snuff dishes, of pure gold.
controles.kjv: And he made his seven lamps, and his snuffers, and his snuffdishes, of pure gold.
controles.livre: Fez também suas sete lâmpadas, e seus tenazes, e seus apagadores, de ouro puro;

versos.hebraico: כִּכָּ֛ר זָהָ֥ב טָה֖וֹר עָשָׂ֣ה אֹתָ֑הּ וְאֵ֖ת כָּל־כֵּלֶֽיהָ׃פ

controles.web: He made it of a talent of pure gold, with all its vessels.
controles.kjv: Of a talent of pure gold made he it, and all the vessels thereof.
controles.livre: De um talento de ouro puro o fez, com todos os seus utensílios.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֛עַשׂ אֶת־מִזְבַּ֥ח הַקְּטֹ֖רֶת עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים אַמָּ֣ה אָרְכּוֹ֩ וְאַמָּ֨ה רָחְבּ֜וֹ רָב֗וּעַ וְאַמָּתַ֨יִם֙ קֹֽמָת֔וֹ מִמֶּ֖נּוּ הָי֥וּ קַרְנֹתָֽיו׃

controles.web: He made the altar of incense of acacia wood. It was square: its length was a cubit, and its breadth a cubit. Its height was two cubits. Its horns were of one piece with it.
controles.kjv: And he made the incense altar of shittim wood: the length of it was a cubit, and the breadth of it a cubit; it was foursquare; and two cubits was the height of it; the horns thereof were of the same.
controles.livre: Fez também o altar do incenso de madeira de acácia: um côvado seu comprimento, e outro côvado sua largura, era quadrado; e sua altura de dois côvados; e suas pontas da mesma peça.

versos.hebraico: וַיְצַ֨ף אֹת֜וֹ זָהָ֣ב טָה֗וֹר אֶת־גַּגּ֧וֹ וְאֶת־קִירֹתָ֛יו סָבִ֖יב וְאֶת־קַרְנֹתָ֑יו וַיַּ֥עַשׂ ל֛וֹ זֵ֥ר זָהָ֖ב סָבִֽיב׃

controles.web: He overlaid it with pure gold, its top, its sides around it, and its horns. He made a gold molding around it.
controles.kjv: And he overlaid it with pure gold, both the top of it, and the sides thereof round about, and the horns of it: also he made unto it a crown of gold round about.
controles.livre: E cobriu-o de ouro puro, sua mesa e suas paredes ao redor, e suas pontas: e fez-lhe uma coroa de ouro ao redor.

versos.hebraico: וּשְׁתֵּי֩ טַבְּעֹ֨ת זָהָ֜ב עָֽשָׂה־ל֣וֹ׀ מִתַּ֣חַת לְזֵר֗וֹ עַ֚ל שְׁתֵּ֣י צַלְעֹתָ֔יו עַ֖ל שְׁנֵ֣י צִדָּ֑יו לְבָתִּ֣ים לְבַדִּ֔ים לָשֵׂ֥את אֹת֖וֹ בָּהֶֽם׃

controles.web: He made two golden rings for it under its molding crown, on its two ribs, on its two sides, for places for poles with which to carry it.
controles.kjv: And he made two rings of gold for it under the crown thereof, by the two corners of it, upon the two sides thereof, to be places for the staves to bear it withal.
controles.livre: Fez-lhe também dois anéis de ouro debaixo da coroa nos dois cantos aos dois lados, para passar por eles as varas com que havia de ser conduzido.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ אֶת־הַבַּדִּ֖ים עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים וַיְצַ֥ף אֹתָ֖ם זָהָֽב׃

controles.web: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold.
controles.kjv: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold.
controles.livre: E fez as varas de madeira de acácia, e cobriu-as de ouro.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֜עַשׂ אֶת־שֶׁ֤מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה֙ קֹ֔דֶשׁ וְאֶת־קְטֹ֥רֶת הַסַּמִּ֖ים טָה֑וֹר מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה רֹקֵֽחַ׃פ

controles.web: He made the holy anointing oil and the pure incense of sweet spices, after the art of the perfumer.
controles.kjv: And he made the holy anointing oil, and the pure incense of sweet spices, according to the work of the apothecary.
controles.livre: Fez também o azeite santo da unção, e o fino incenso aromático, de obra de perfumista.
